'''Gold''' can refer to the following:

==Chapter titles==
* ''[[The Shadow Rising/Chapter 56|Goldeneyes]]'' - the fifty-sixth chapter of ''[[The Shadow Rising]]''.
* ''[[A Crown of Swords/Chapter 3|Hill of the Golden Dawn]]'' - the third chapter of ''[[A Crown of Swords]]''.
* ''[[Knife of Dreams/Chapter 20|The Golden Crane]]'' - the twentieth chapter of ''[[Knife of Dreams]]''.
* ''[[The Gathering Storm/Chapter 50|Veins of Gold]]'' - the fiftieth chapter of ''[[The Gathering Storm]]''.

==[[Inn]]s==
* [[The Golden Barge]] - an inn in [[So Habor]].
* [[The Golden Ducks]] - an inn in [[Ebou Dar]].
* [[The Golden Crown of Heaven]] - an inn in the [[Rahad]] district of Ebou Dar.
* [[The Golden Swans of Heaven]] - an inn in Ebou Dar.

==[[Old Tongue]]==
* ''[[Al'cair'rahienallen]]'' - a word in the Old Tongue that means "The Hill of the Golden Dawn," a former name for [[Cairhien]].
* ''cair'' - a word in the Old Tongue that means "gold."
* ''[[Sei'cair]]'' - a word in the Old Tongue that means "the eyes of gold."

==''[[Ter'angreal]]''==
* [[Golden crescents]] - a ''ter'angreal'' that is part of [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]]'s [[paralis-net]].
* [[Golden hummingbird]] - a ''ter'angreal'' that is part of Cadsuane Melaidhrin's paralis-net.
* [[Golden swallow]] - a ''ter'angreal'' that is part of Cadsuane Melaidhrin's paralis-net.

==Other==
* [[Alcair Dal]] - a location in the [[Aiel Waste]], whose name means "The Gold Bowl" in the Old Tongue.
* [[Captain of the Gold]] - a rank among the [[Seanchan]] [[Ever Victorious Army]].
* [[Measurement#Coinage|Gold]] - used in the making of coins.
* [[Golden Crane]] - a symbol of [[Malkier]].
* [[Golden Crane signet ring]] - the ring of Malkieri kings, given to [[El'Nynaeve ti al'Meara Mandragoran|Nynaeve]] by [[Al'Lan Mandragoran|Lan]].
* [[Gold Road]] - a major highway linking [[Illian (city)|Illian]] and [[Far Madding]].
* [[:Category:Goldsmiths|Goldsmiths]] - people who work and forge gold.
